text:
Maya Support: FYI urgent - Brightspan (acct BS-555) dedicated onboarding stuck: dedicated cluster provisioning failed due to VPC peering policy. Ticket: https://redwood.zd/ticket/78221
Diego CS: renewal in how many days? who's CSM? @Priya
Maya Support: renewal ~29 days. CSM is Priya CS. They've committed to a pilot on dedicated infra w/ sensitive data.
Priya CS: thanks. this is high priority. Maya, paste the error & whatever infra returned.
Maya Support: error snippet:
```
ProvisionError: VPC_PEER_POLICY_DENIED - peering request blocked by customer org firewall rules (policy: deny-external-peers)
Request ID: req-0a9f12
```
Maya Support: we retried once; same result. Infra team needs customer's network contact to approve peer or provide a peering token.
Priya CS: plan (short): 1) warm transfer to CS in 20m, 2) send exec-friendly status now, 3) coordinate SOW/network contact + comms templates, 4) prepare fallback: short-term hosted seats for pilot while peering is approved. I can own handoff if @Diego ok.
Diego CS: I can take it. I'll create a shared invite with their NetOps and Security, set success metric: dedicated cluster online within 72h or pilot coverage via hosted fallback in 24h.
Omar Infra: technical note - customer policy `deny-external-peers` requires a signed peering token from their NetOps and a routing allowlist. We can accept a pre-shared peering token instead of live peering if customer ops prefer. Fallback commands (internal):
```
# generate pre-share token
redwood infra generate-peering-token --org BS-555 --expires 24h
# provision with token
redwood infra provision-dedicated --org BS-555 --region us-west --peering-token <TOKEN>
```
Omar Infra: will need their VPC cidr and the approval email address to send the token.
Zoe Security: heads-up - if we use pre-shared peering token, we require SOC approval and an encrypted transit policy in the SOW. I'll review but can fast-track for pilots.
Priya CS: communications: two templates - exec-friendly (business impact + ETA) and ops-facing (detailed steps for NetOps). Maya please send exec-friendly now: "We're blocked on VPC peering approval for Dedicated. We're preparing a hosted fallback for the pilot and will coordinate a token-based peering option with your NetOps. Expect a follow-up with scheduling details." :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Maya Support: sent at 4298765450. Customer replied: "Thanks. We'll loop NetOps and security. Please include SOW details and the token option." :thumbsup:
Diego CS: owners recap: Diego -> warm transfer + invite (include NetOps contact & security); Omar -> prepare token flow & one-click commands; Zoe -> fast-track SOC review for token; Priya -> create renewal watch & AE coordination; Ava AE -> prep renewal outreach if dedicated not live in 72h.
Ava AE: noted. I'll prepare a brief for exec sponsor and draft outreach to protect renewal; will standby for outcome.
Priya CS: product feedback capture - onboarding flow should include a dedicated-network checklist and a pre-approved peering token option in quickstart. Filing to product board.
OpsBot: Task created: BS-555-dedicated-peering-handshake assigned to Diego, due 4298768812.
Diego CS: I'll mark account health as "at-risk - infra dependency" and start a 48h cadence touch. I'll post summary here after the warm transfer. Thanks team. :white_check_mark:
